title: Preparing an apartment for sale in Dushanbe: price and process
excerpt: Prepare property information, compare similar offers, arrange photographs and viewings and agree agency terms. No fixed selling date is promised.
contentHtml:
Substantively checked and updated on 16 October 2026.

A sale plan starts with an accurate property description and clear owner expectations. Separate the desired price from confirmed particulars and identify material terms and timing in advance. A district name alone does not determine transaction speed.

Collect property particulars

Prepare the area, floor, building height, condition, included items and known document issues. Compare information with records and explain discrepancies. Do not advertise new renovation or readiness to occupy unless it reflects the actual condition. Agree viewing access and who participates in the decision to sell.

Compare prices for similar options

Compare active apartments with similar area, location and condition. Consider furniture and necessary works. Advertised prices do not establish completed transaction prices; a lack of calls does not prove one particular cause. Set an initial price, acceptable negotiation terms and a date to review genuine responses together.

Prepare photographs and viewings

Photograph the current condition without editing that conceals defects. Show principal rooms and layout and clarify included items. Agree timing, access and responsibility for each viewing. Collect specific visitor questions and observations rather than relying solely on a page-view counter.

Agree agency work in writing

Clarify services, remuneration, expenses, publication channels and viewing arrangements before advertising starts. Establish who handles enquiries and how price changes are agreed. An ordinary agency sale and a possible buyout are different options. A website enquiry does not commit the agency to buying or selling by a fixed date.

Prepare completion terms

Agree document checks, payment arrangements and property and contents handover. Establish applicable requirements and costs with professionals for your situation. Do not rely on a universal division of fees or a claim that one payment instrument removes every risk. Record material agreements before money changes hands.

faq.q: Can the district determine a promised selling time?
faq.a: No. Advertisement counts and website views do not establish a selling time for an individual apartment. Price, condition, terms and genuine negotiations matter.
Establish applicable costs and their allocation for the particular situation and record the agreement. This article does not prescribe a universal equal split.
